description: Calculate where the planets stand in the sidereal zodiac at a moment with Moon Dasha: the nine grahas with sign, degree, nakshatra and pada, dignity, retrograde and combust, when each entered its sign and when it leaves; the retrograde run of Mercury to Saturn, current or next; the ascendant when a place is given; the Moon's tithi, phase and how much of it is lit. Default: now. For another moment give a date (and a time), on the clock of the place (a place_id from find_place) or of a time_zone alone; UTC when neither is given. Set outer_planets only when the reader asks about Uranus, Neptune or Pluto. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, on the clock of the place or time_zone (UTC without either). Leave out date and time for now.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

outer_planets.description: Also list Uranus, Neptune and Pluto. Set it only when the reader asks about them.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned, for the ascendant and the local clock. Optional: without a place the answer has no ascendant.

time.description: The time of day on that clock, 24-hour HH:MM. Default 12:00 when a date is given; with no date, today at that time.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata", for its clock alone, without a place or an ascendant. Leave it out when giving a place_id, whose own clock is used.

name: planetary_positions

ascendant.description: The lagna; null without a place.

clock.description: Whose clock the times are on: the place's, a time zone's, or UTC when neither was given.

moment.description: ISO 8601 on the answer's clock, with its offset.

noon_by_default.description: A date was given without a time, so the moment is 12:00.

combust.description: Null for Uranus, Neptune and Pluto.

dignity.description: Null for Uranus, Neptune and Pluto.

in_sign_since.description: ISO 8601 on the answer's clock, with its offset.

end.description: ISO 8601 on the answer's clock, with its offset.

start.description: ISO 8601 on the answer's clock, with its offset.

retrograde_period.description: Mercury to Saturn (and Uranus to Pluto when listed): the retrograde run holding the moment, or the next one; null for the Sun, Moon, Rahu and Ketu.

speed.description: Degrees a day; below zero is retrograde.

until.description: ISO 8601 on the answer's clock, with its offset.

skipped_time.description: The time asked for when the clock skipped it that day (the clocks went forward): the moment is that instant, read after the change.

title: Planetary positions
